post_call_analysis_data.name: business_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's business name, if given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: business_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: The kind of business (for example: HVAC, plumbing, dental).

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_number
post_call_analysis_data.description: The callback number the caller confirmed, in E.164 format (+1XXXXXXXXXX). Empty if not confirmed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: avg_job_value
post_call_analysis_data.description: The average job value the caller said, in their words. Empty if not said.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if a call with the founder or an audit was booked on this call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: The booked day and time in plain words. Empty if nothing was booked.

post_call_analysis_data.name: sms_ok
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the caller clearly said yes to receiving a text message.

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgent
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller asked the founder to call back today.

post_call_analysis_data.name: lead_temperature
post_call_analysis_data.description: Hot: wants to book or start. Warm: interested, not ready. Cold: not interested or not a business owner.
